description: This Java class defines a centralized exception handler for REST API endpoints in a Spring-based web application. It captures specific exceptions like validation errors and illegal arguments, as well as general exceptions, to produce consistent error responses with detailed information.

classes.name: ApiExceptionHandler
classes.description: A REST controller advice class that manages exception handling for REST endpoints, providing consistent error responses for validation issues, illegal arguments, and unexpected errors.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation exceptions, constructs a ProblemDetail response indicating validation failure, includes error details.

methods.name: handleIllegalArgument
methods.description: Handles IllegalArgumentExceptions, returns a ProblemDetail with the exception message.

methods.name: handleUnexpected
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions, logs the error, and returns a generic server error response.

methods.name: fieldErrorToMap
methods.description: Converts a FieldError into a Map containing the field name and message.
